units.title: Eicosanoid Synthesis and Inhibitors
units.guide: Arachidonic acid —COX I/II→ PG (pain, pyrexia, inflammation) and TXA2 (platelet aggregation); —5-LOX→ LTC4/D4 (bronchoconstrictors). NSAIDs reversible except aspirin (irreversible). Zileuton blocks 5-LOX; montelukast/zafirlukast block LT receptors.

units.title: Prostaglandin E1 and E2 Analogs
units.sec: Prostaglandin E1 and E2 Analogs · p237
units.guide: PGE1 keeps the ductus arteriosus patent. Misoprostol: NSAID gastric ulcer, abortion, PPH (least effective). Alprostadil: ED. Sildenafil is DOC for ED. PGE2 dinoprostone: PPH and cervical ripening DOC.

units.title: Prostaglandin I2, F2α and Other PHTN Drugs
units.sec: Prostaglandin I2, F2α and Other PHTN Drugs · p237
units.guide: PGI2: pulmonary HTN (vasodilation) — epoprostenol (recombinant), iloprost/beraprost/treprostinil (analogs), selexipag (receptor agonist). Endothelin antagonists: bosentan, ambrisentan. PGF2α: carboprost (PPH, abortion); latanoprost/bimatoprost eye drops DOC open-angle / normal-tension glaucoma. S/E: heterochromia, sandy eyes, macular edema, hypertrichosis (used for hypotrichosis). C/I uveitis.

units.title: Non-Selective COX Inhibitors: Paracetamol
units.guide: Paracetamol: COX I/II ↓PG (analgesia, antipyrexia, poor anti-inflammatory) + TRPV1 and cannabinoid receptors. M/c drug-induced liver failure via NAPQI depleting glutathione → centrilobular necrosis + periportal sparing. M/c drug poisoning. Toxic 150–250 mg/kg or >10 g; fatal >20 g. Rumack-Matthew nomogram. <4 h charcoal; DOC NAC; failure → transplant.

units.title: Aspirin: Dose Dependent Effects and Uses
units.sec: Aspirin: Dose Dependent Effects and Uses · p239
units.guide: 50–325 mg OD antiaggregant; 325–650 mg SOS analgesic/antipyretic; 3–4 g/day anti-inflammatory. Uses include RA, rheumatic fever, niacin flushing DOC, essential thrombocythemia, Kawasaki, ↓ colon cancer. S/E: bleeding m/c; Reye; salicylism >10 g (seizures, tinnitus, hyperglycemia, metabolic acidosis) — symptomatic ± dialysis. C/I: viral fever in children, gout, warfarin.

units.title: Other Non-Selective NSAIDs: Indomethacin to Ketorolac
units.sec: Other Non-Selective NSAIDs: Indomethacin to Ketorolac · p240
units.guide: Indomethacin: COX + PLA/C + leucocyte migration; DOC acute gout, Bartter, paroxysmal hemicrania; frontal headache. Sulindac: FAP / colon, breast, prostate cancer risk ↓. Ibuprofen: PDA closure DOC in India (worldwide DOC indomethacin); aseptic meningitis, toxic amblyopia. Ketoprofen also blocks LOX. Flurbiprofen eye drops prevent intra-op miosis. Piroxicam enterohepatic, longest, slow, chronic pain. Ketorolac high potency — acute pain, nasal migraine, ocular drops.

units.title: Diclofenac, Naproxen and Selective COX II Inhibitors
units.sec: Diclofenac, Naproxen and Selective COX II Inhibitors · p241
units.guide: Diclofenac: short T1/2 but long acting (joints); hepatotoxic, GI ulcers ↓ by misoprostol combo. Nabumetone: non-acidic, long, OD. COX-2: celecoxib, etoricoxib oral; parecoxib IV post-op. 3rd-line for pain. S/E: hypersensitivity rash m/c, renal papillary necrosis, cardiotoxicity (rofecoxib, valdecoxib). Ulcer: non-selective > selective; DOC PPIs. Interactions: ↓ antihypertensives, ↓ lithium clearance, ↓ furosemide.
